title: 第二章 决战教皇
lines: 战况非常焦灼，killer选择的是虫族，rush战术并没有成功，虫族对人族，如果前期不能取得优势等于输了八成，身经百战的look显然洞察了对手的意图，教皇的称号可不是白来的。对手的操作很惊人，迫使他前期都要全力防御，但还是太小觑职业选手了，防空和雷达已经做好，对手想要翻盘的唯一方法就是空运地刺破坏经济，这是痴心妄想，最多五分钟之后，就是人族的绝对碾压期，他的运营，此时就算换一个一般的选手来接替自己都能赢。
look的脸上露出了自信的笑容，此时在网吧的角落里有一个西装革履的男子，脸型有点长，跟整个环境都格格不入，这是来自韩国ssg电竞俱乐部的总经理，作为曾经的豪门，随着sk的制霸，整个俱乐部都陷入了困境当中，国内的资源几乎被sk垄断，他只能把眼光放的更远。
说真的，他自己都觉得不可思议，竟然会来一个电竞还处于蛮荒的国度挖掘选手，可是在第一次看到killer的视频集锦时就被深深吸引了，当知道这个玩家只有14岁，朱镇钟立刻买了来上海的机票，费尽心思找到了比赛的网吧，正如他判断的，killer果然打进了决赛，要知道，这个过程中，他已经淘汰了两名韩国职业选手，面对的是恐怖的教皇look。
坦白说，战术上并不出奇，可怕的是他的反应和操作，作为专业人士，他感觉汗毛炸立。
这可能是ssg走出困境的唯一机会！
前四局两人打成了二比二平，这个比分显然是任何人都没有预测到的，几乎所有人都认为look将三比零轻松获胜，无法想象，一个非职业选手竟然把如日中天的教皇逼到这个地步，而前四局双方的apm已经超过400，这是什么概念，一般拥有两百多的手速就可以打职业了，三百多就是顶尖高手，而两人已经狂飙到了四百多，而且持续了四局，这样的能力全世界不超过三个。
但这一局，killer没戏了，作为总经理兼教练，朱镇钟的判断无疑是精准的，此时国内各处的网吧几乎都在看这场比赛，由于电竞还处于萌芽阶段，唯一的直播途径就是一个电竞爱好者的平台pul。
网吧弥漫着一种窒息的绝望，如果没有前两场的胜利大概还不会如此难受，别说朱镇钟了，但凡有点基础的都是知道状况。
rush战术的失败对虫族来说，意味着不存在运营打后期的可能，飞龙还是地刺？必须孤注一掷的投机一把。
killer选择了飞龙，这比地刺有操作空间，可是look已经完全洞察了，家里已经在憋防空塔和隐飞，&hellip;&hellip;完克。
朱镇钟咬着手指，这是他纠结时的习惯，作为韩国人他当然希望look赢，但是作为ssg的总经理，他希望killer赢，这样对他的后续崛起计划有极大的助力，电竞固然是竞技，也是需要一定噱头和标签的，战胜look的天才，绝对可以引爆韩国电竞圈。
赛场上的killer已经完全防御，所有经济都用来出飞龙，但对面的等待他的是战斗力更强的影飞加防空塔加机枪兵的混合部队，稍微了解一点的人都知道，完虐飞龙。
&ldquo;出点小狗配合一下是不是更好？&rdquo;
&ldquo;得了吧，哪儿有钱，前期亏太多，这是要孤注一掷了。&rdquo;
&ldquo;这点飞龙还不够教皇塞牙缝的，哎，最后一刻功亏一篑，那农民探路简直神了，像开图打啊。&rdquo;
&ldquo;唉，鬼知道，这大概是神级意识吧，这个时候我上都能赢了。&rdquo;
金阳网吧里的观众窃窃私语，望着单独在坐在一个包间里的瘦小身影，他们距离希望是那么的近，如果能够战胜look真是可以吹一辈子了，这相当于一个篮球业余选手单挑赢了科比，但现在看显然是不可能的了。
战场上，飞龙出动，而对面防御塔加隐飞早就待命，甩飞龙，毫无疑问是一个虫族高手必须的，可问题是对手是顶尖的人族，单靠这个是一点希望都没有。
果然，第一队飞龙甩的非常漂亮，但在人族完美的防御下，没有收到任何战果，killer还憋别飞龙，丝毫没有出其他兵种的意思，摆在他面前的是华山一条路，明知道尽头是悬崖也只能硬着头皮走了。
朱镇钟看了一眼比赛中的killer，这小孩嘴角还带着一丝&hellip;&hellip;笑意，大概是错觉吧，或许他对这个结果已经满意了，这个不好，作为一个职业选手，要有一颗对冠军永不放弃的心。
&ldquo;给我一杯咖啡。&rdquo;朱镇钟转过身来到吧台，他是个中国通，带着一点东北腔儿，朱镇钟判断中国电竞未来将是世界第一大市场，所以一直在积极准备着，当然因为这个在韩国国内也被同行嘲笑了很久。
前台的妹子没好气的白了对方一眼，韩国鬼子是想看笑话嘛！
望着对方气鼓鼓的样子，朱镇钟无奈的笑了笑，&ldquo;我是killer的粉丝。&rdquo;
&ldquo;哟，大叔，中文不错嘛，送你一杯，有眼光啊。&rdquo;妹子立刻变得阳光灿烂，态度180度漂移。
无论最终结果是什么，朱镇钟已经下定决心把killer带回韩国，只要加以训练，以他的年纪和天赋，绝对能和教皇抗衡，甚至超越。
天赋、灵性、耐心、任性，更重要的是年轻，这都是成为一名优秀职业选手的要素，而他全具备了。
想到这里朱镇钟舒服多了，对于比赛的结果也就不怎么在意了。
赛场中，飞龙对抗影飞加防御塔是没戏的，由于经济的劣势，飞龙的数量有点不足，并没有起到战术打击作用，但是look却感觉到一丝丝不对劲，对方并没有跟自己拼命，而是在牵扯，飞龙不断的拉扯，&hellip;&hellip;拖延？
这没用啊，越拖自己的经济越好，兵粮越多，拖时间只会让胜利天平更偏向自己这边，换一个对手look早就横推了，但是前四局的战斗让look心生警惕，基地的雷达扫过去，对方真的还在出飞龙，没有任何花招？
难道是自己想多了？
时间就这样一分一秒的过去，飞龙的数量变成了两队，但&hellip;&hellip;说真的，这样的数量面对人族防空塔、机枪兵、影飞的混合搭配根本没用，最多五分钟，人族的大部队就可以推出去了。
网吧里终于忍不住了爆出了一片的绝望，各种叹息。
（亲爱的伙伴们，今天爆更，求第一个收藏，第一张推荐票，感谢！）
content_en:
The battle situation was very tense. Killer chose the Zerg, and the rush tactic was not successful. Zerg vs. Terran, if you can't gain an advantage in the early stage, you will lose 80% of the time. Look, who has experienced many battles, obviously has an insight into the opponent's intentions. The title of Pope is not for nothing. The opponent's operation is amazing, forcing him to defend with all his strength in the early stage, but he still underestimates the professional players. The air defense and radar are already in place. The only way for the opponent to make a comeback is to use airborne ground assassins to destroy the economy. This is a wishful thinking. After five minutes at most, it will be the absolute crushing period of the human race. With his operation, even if an ordinary player replaces him at this time, he can win.
A confident smile appeared on Look's face. At this time, there was a man in a suit and leather shoes in the corner of the Internet cafe. His face was a bit long and he was out of tune with the entire environment. He was the general manager of the SSG e-sports club in South Korea. As a former wealthy club, with the dominance of SK, the entire club was in trouble. Domestic resources were almost monopolized by SK, so he could only look further.
To be honest, he himself found it incredible that he would come to a country where e-sports was still in the wild to discover players. However, he was deeply attracted when he saw Killer's video highlights for the first time. When he found out that this player was only 14 years old, Zhu Zhenzhong immediately bought a ticket to Shanghai and tried his best to find the Internet cafe where the competition was held. As he judged, Killer had indeed made it to the finals. You know, in the process, he had eliminated two Korean professional players and faced the terrifying Pope look.
Frankly speaking, the tactics were not surprising. What was scary was his reaction and operation. As a professional, he felt like the hair on his head was standing on end.
This may be ssg's only chance to get out of trouble!
In the first four rounds, the two tied at 2-2. This score was obviously something that no one had predicted. Almost everyone thought that Look would easily win 3-0. It was unimaginable that a non-professional player could force the pope to this point, and the first four The APM of both sides of the game has exceeded 400. What is the concept? Generally speaking, a hand speed of more than 200 is enough to play professionally, and a hand speed of more than 300 is a top player. However, the two of them have reached more than 400 and lasted for four games. There are only three people with such ability in the world.
But in this game, Killer is out of the question. As the general manager and coach, Zhu Zhenzhong’s judgment is undoubtedly accurate. At this time, almost all Internet cafes in the country are watching this game. Since e-sports is still in its infancy, the only way to live broadcast is pul, a platform for e-sports enthusiasts.
There was a kind of suffocating despair in the Internet cafe. If it hadn't been for the first two victories, it probably wouldn't be so uncomfortable. Let alone Zhu Zhenzhong, anyone with a little basic knowledge would know the situation.
The failure of rush tactics means that for the Zerg, there is no possibility of operating in the late stage. Flying dragon or ground thorn? One must make a desperate move.
Killer chose Flying Dragon, which has more room for maneuver than Ground Thorn, but Look had already fully understood, and the family was already holding back Air Defense Tower and Invisible Flying,... it was over.
Zhu Zhenzhong bit his finger. This was his habit when he was in a dilemma. As a Korean, of course he wanted Look to win, but as the general manager of SSG, he wanted Killer to win. This would greatly help his subsequent rise plan. E-sports is a competition, and it also requires certain gimmicks and labels. A genius who defeats Look can definitely detonate the Korean e-sports circle.
Killer on the field has been completely defended, and all the economy has been used to produce flying dragons, but what awaits him on the opposite side is a more powerful mixed force of shadow flying plus anti-aircraft towers and machine gunners. Anyone who knows a little bit knows that it will completely destroy the flying dragon.
"Wouldn't it be better to have some puppies to cooperate?" ”
"Come on, where is the money? I've lost too much in the early stage, so I have to put all my money into it." ”
"This flying dragon is not enough to scare the Pope. Alas, the success fell short at the last moment. The farmer's pathfinding was amazing, like a map." ”
"Oh, who knows, this is probably a god-level consciousness. At this time, I can win." ”
The audience in Jinyang Internet Cafe whispered, looking at the thin figure sitting alone in a private room. They were so close to hope. If they could defeat Look, they would be able to brag for a lifetime. This was equivalent to an amateur basketball player beating Kobe in a one-on-one, but it is obviously impossible now.
On the battlefield, the flying dragon is dispatched, and the opposite defense tower and the invisible flying are already on standby. Driving away the flying dragon is undoubtedly a must for a Zerg master, but the problem is that the opponent is a top human race, and relying on this alone has no hope at all.
Sure enough, the first team of flying dragons swung very beautifully, but under the perfect defense of the human race, they did not receive any results. Killer still held back the flying dragons and showed no intention of sending out other troops. The road in front of him was a road in Huashan. He could only bite the bullet and walk away knowing that there was a cliff at the end.
Zhu Zhenzhong glanced at the killer in the game. The kid still had a smile on his face. It was probably an illusion. Maybe he was satisfied with the result. This is not good. As a professional player, you must have a heart that never gives up on the championship.
“Give me a cup of coffee. "Zhu Zhenzhong turned around and came to the bar. He is a China expert with a Northeastern accent. Zhu Zhenzhong believes that China's e-sports will be the world's largest market in the future, so he has been actively preparing for it. Of course, this has been ridiculed by his peers in South Korea for a long time.
The girl at the front desk rolled her eyes angrily, the Korean devil just wanted to see a joke!
Looking at the other party's angry look, Zhu Zhenzhong smiled helplessly, "I'm a fan of Killer." ”
"Hey, uncle, your Chinese is pretty good. I'll give you a drink. You're very discerning." ”The girl immediately became sunny and her attitude drifted 180 degrees.
No matter what the final result is, Zhu Zhenzhong has made up his mind to bring Killer back to South Korea. As long as he is trained, with his age and talent, he will definitely be able to compete with the Pope or even surpass him.
Talent, spirituality, patience, willfulness, and more importantly, youth, these are the elements to become an excellent professional player, and he has them all.
Thinking of this, Zhu Zhenzhong felt much better and didn't care much about the result of the game.
In the arena, there was no chance for Feilong to fight against Shadow Fei and the defense tower. Due to the economic disadvantage, the number of Feilongs was a bit insufficient and did not play a tactical role. However, Look felt something was wrong. The opponent did not fight with him desperately, but was pulling. Feilong kept pulling,... Delay?
It's useless. The longer you delay, the better your economy will be and the more troops you will have. Delaying time will only tilt the balance of victory to your side. If it were another opponent, Look would have pushed him. But the battles in the first four rounds made Look wary. The base's radar swept over and saw that the opponent was really still sending flying dragons without any tricks?
Could it be that I am overthinking it?
Time passed by like this, and the number of flying dragons became two teams, but...seriously, such a number was useless against the mix of human air defense towers, machine gunners, and shadow flies. In five minutes at most, the large human force could be pushed out.
Finally, the Internet cafe couldn't help but erupted in despair and sighs.

title_en: Chapter 2 The decisive battle with the Pope
